name: dartamas | درتماس
author: dartamas

sections.description:
This is a dartamas.com Plugin for our customers that should contacts to their online support tean, in this Plugin we use my.siponline.ir to get Voip functionality.

Third-Party Service Disclosure
Dartamas Plugin and Third-Party Service Dependency

This plugin, Dartamas, relies on a third-party service provided by sipOnline to enable certain functionalities of the plugin. Specifically, the plugin uses a script hosted at https://my.siponline.ir/chatButtonModule.js to implement the call button feature on your website.

Circumstances Under Which Third-Party Services Are Used
The sipOnline service is used under the following circumstances:

When you add the Dartamas call button to your website, a JavaScript file (chatButtonModule.js) is loaded from https://my.siponline.ir/.
The script is responsible for managing interactions related to the call button, including visual elements, positioning, and event handling.
The plugin sends certain data attributes to this third-party script, such as:
The position of the call button (e.g., bottom_right).
A token used to authenticate or customize the button’s settings.
Links to Service Terms of Use and Privacy Policies
For your reference, please review the terms of use and privacy policies of the service:

Use of Third-Party Service (sipOnline)

This plugin uses the external service sipOnline to manage the VoIP call button functionality. Specifically, the plugin loads a JavaScript file from https://my.siponline.ir/chatButtonModule.js to enable the call button on your website.

Data Sent to Third-Party Service

When you use the Dartamas call button, the following data attributes are sent to sipOnline:

  • Position of the Call Button: e.g., bottom_right.
  • Margin for Display: Custom spacing values for the button.
  • Token: A unique token used to authenticate or customize the button’s settings.

This data is necessary for configuring the appearance and functionality of the call button on your site.

Links to Service Terms of Use and Privacy Policies

Before using this plugin, please review the following documents from the external service provider, sipOnline:

  • Service Website
  • Terms of Use
  • Privacy Policy
sections.installation:
1. Upload the Dartamas plugin to your WordPress site.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress.
  3. Go to the Dartamas settings and configure your token and preferences.
  4. The VoIP call button will be displayed based on your settings.
sections.faq:
What is the purpose of the Dartamas plugin?

The plugin allows users to make direct VoIP calls to your online support team, enhancing customer support interaction on your website.

What third-party service is being used?

The plugin relies on the sipOnline service for VoIP functionality.

What data is shared with the third-party service?

The plugin sends positioning, margin, and token data to configure the call button functionality on the site.
